intelligence.human_view: He asked what it says, not what it is — because an emblem is not a logo, it is a voice. What this one says is "this is for real": a crowned jewel with wings reads like something from a vault, not a screen, and a seal on a deed reads official, precious, yours. That is the feeling the official areas have to carry, and it is why the render matters: the sharper crown, the more real wings, the more light in the diamond — that is what makes the eye say "wow, that looks for real." Keep the same quality is the whole instruction: wherever the emblem goes, it must look as real as the original, or it stops saying what it says.
intelligence.simple_view: Which one is the prettiest? The second one! The crown is sharper and the diamond sparkles more. And what does it say? It says: this is for real! Like a real jewel from a treasure chest, with wings!
